import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(13.4, 26.8)
    .faces("<Z")
    .chamfer(1.0)
    .faces(">Z")
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .polarArray(20.9, 0, 360, 6)
    .hole(3.2)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 8.0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(2.6, 15.4)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 23.05), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(27.5, 12.0)
    )
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(11.2)
)
show_object(result)
